title: [GAP-11] Required disclosures have no accessibility or language requirements
description: Review finding GAP-11: Required disclosures have no accessibility or language requirements (lens GAP). Location: spec/06-calls.md:293-308; spec/07-compliance.md:120-126, 227-229; spec/05-messaging.md:163. Fix: Confirmed: there is no hit for accessibility, audible or localize. The "accessible" at 07:126 means reachable from the info panel. Lowered to P3. The disclosures are already required as text system messages (06:293), which assistive technology reads, and the CO writes the disclosure strings in whatever language it chooses. The real residual gaps are audio-only and headless devices in calls, and icon-only indicators (05:163). Fix: require a programmatic text equivalent for every mandated indicator, an audible notice before media for recording disclosures on devices without a display, and optional BCP 47 language maps for the disclosure strings. This does not touch the recording-consent decision. Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
